headline: I keep paying what I owe. Why is my money still blocked?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing MONEY_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing showed through the backs, but your hand still found the worker.
Both hands are busy above a table full of working tools.
You said you keep paying what you owe and asked why the money stays blocked. The work already happening catches my eye.
The payments continue, and the money remains blocked.
Something reaches the result just where the work should open it. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You couldn't see the card, yet you chose the one with a single restraint.
One rope circles one ankle. No other part of him is tied.
You asked why the money is held while you keep paying. This card brings me to that single rope.
Still, the action you named keeps happening while the result stays held.
Something stands between the payments and the money changing. I don't think it began with you.
Let me see what's holding the money…
c: You turned the Fool. The backs told you nothing, but your hand went to the one travelling light.
Look at the bundle on his stick. It moves with him.
You asked why the result has not moved with what you are paying. The carried bundle is where this card takes me.
And yet the money has not moved, though you keep carrying what you owe.
The thing that has hold of the money keeps it apart from what you already carry. I don't think this began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of the result…
